summary: Make MemoryStorage write operations (update, remove, insert_multiple) atomic like JSONStorage (all-or-nothing on exception) and ensure the search cache is invalidated after any write, success or failure, so searches always reflect stored data.

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.update(delete('tmp')) is called and raises KeyError

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.update(delete('tmp')) is called and raises KeyError
acceptance_criteria.then: the KeyError is raised (exception type unchanged)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.remove(Query().tmp.exists()) is called and raises an exception (e.g., a custom test function that raises)
acceptance_criteria.then: db.all() returns the original data unchanged

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.insert_multiple([{'name': 'b'}, {'name': 'c', 'bad': 1/0}]) is called and raises ZeroDivisionError

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.search(Query().tmp.exists()) is called, then db.update(delete('tmp')) is called and raises KeyError, then db.search(Query().tmp.exists()) is called again
acceptance_criteria.then: the second search returns [] (matching the actual stored data, not the stale cache)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.search(Query().name == 'a') is called, then db.insert({'name': 'b'}) succeeds, then db.search(Query().name == 'b') is called
acceptance_criteria.then: the second search returns [{'name': 'b'}] (cache invalidated on successful write)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with JSONStorage (temp file) containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.update(delete('tmp')) is called and raises KeyError
acceptance_criteria.then: the JSON file content is unchanged and db.all() returns the original data (existing behaviour preserved)

assumptions.assumption: Maintainer accepts that MemoryStorage should match JSONStorage's all-or-nothing semantics (bug, not feature).
assumptions.default_used: Atomicity required for update, remove, insert_multiple on MemoryStorage.

assumptions.assumption: Atomicity can be implemented via copy-on-write or staging buffer; either is acceptable.
assumptions.default_used: Copy-on-write (deep copy before mutation) as conservative default.

assumptions.assumption: Cache invalidation on failed writes belongs in the table layer (where clear_cache() is).
assumptions.default_used: Call Table.clear_cache() in write methods' finally block or after catching exception.

assumptions.assumption: insert_multiple currently has the same partial-failure bug.
assumptions.default_used: Include insert_multiple in the atomicity fix (FR-3).
